title: [Photo] Won Tae-in prevents walk-off loss, pushes game to extra innings

 입력 2026.11.04. 21:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On the 4th at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was held.
 With KT having edged Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the previous day, Game 2 featured a starting matchup between KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Flexen.
 After pitching a scoreless bottom of the ninth, Samsung's Won Tae-in celebrated as he headed into the dugout. Nov. 4, 2026
